messages:
Rory: Quick follow-up from today's tearoom — thought experiment on ingress <-> quota backpressure. TL;DR: proposal to surface an 'admit_hint' in admission responses so callers can decide retry vs fallback. Thoughts?

Maya: interesting. can you sketch the protocol?

Rory: sketch:
```
rpc Admit(Request) returns (AdmissionResult) {
  message AdmissionResult {
    bool admitted = 1;
    string admit_hint = 2; // "retry-after=150ms; fallback=model-small"
    // reason, debug_id
  }
}
```

Maya: i like compact hint. question: who generates fallback suggestion? admission layer or policy service?

Jamal: policy service, imo — it knows capacity/cost. admission should be lightweight.

Priya: security: avoid leaking internal shard metrics in hints. sanitize.

Theo: ops: telemetry must record hint decisions and downstream use. add histogram for 'hint-used' vs 'hint-ignored'.

Li: SDK impact: clients will need idempotent retry helpers. prefer explicit numeric ms instead of text.

Rory: ack. tradeoffs: tighter coupling vs better UX. alternatives: 429 + Retry-After header, or separate /hint endpoint.

Maya: 429 approach is simpler for HTTP, but we lose expressive fallback.

Jamal: also consider cross-region fallbacks: hint could be region=eu-west.

Priya: we must ensure hints don't create oscillations: clients that immediately retry could overload backups.

Rory: propose rate-limit for hint-driven retries (a bit like backoff token). Add 'cooldown' field: ms.

Theo: rollout plan: start with internal-only header, record opt-in metric, experiment with a small set of customers.

Li: action items: (1) proto patch, (2) SDK change, (3) telemetry dashboard.

Rory: cool, i'll open RFC PR with proto diff and rollout checklist. thanks :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: @rory created rfc/admit-hint proto (link: https://go/r/admit-hint)

Maya: added one more: add 'hint_version' so we can evolve format.

Rory: good call. fine to close thread once PR lands.
